key_highlights: ASX posts fourth consecutive losing week as rising bond yields pressure equities across sectors
RBA signals continued rate hikes despite surging unemployment, creating an 'interest rate pincer' for households
AUD experiences sharp depreciation ('trapdoor opens'), raising import costs and commodity-linked equity risk
Australian house prices over halfway to largest 40-year correction, with Victoria hit hardest
Over half of renters now financially stressed, signalling consumer spending deterioration
$2.7B cap raise wave keeps ASX small/mid-cap brokers active; gold exploration hits (Aurum, Zenith, Kuniko) drive junior miner momentum
Star's Sydney casino licence remains suspended, weighing on gaming/entertainment sector
China-US diplomatic engagement (Xi-Trump meeting) provides partial commodity demand support

sectors.trend: Junior gold explorers (Aurum 155g/t, Zenith 6/6 hits in WA, Kuniko NSW) showing strong assay results; however, AUD weakness and falling house prices may pressure large-cap miners (BHP, RIO, FMG) via reduced domestic demand and global risk-off flows. China-US détente offers partial iron ore support.
sectors.implications: Gold juniors attract speculative capital; large-cap miners face mixed signals from AUD depreciation vs. China demand. Cap raise activity ($2.7B) dilutes small-cap holders.

sectors.trend: RBA hawkish stance despite unemployment surge supports net interest margins for CBA, NAB, ANZ, WBC. However, rising unemployment and renter stress (50%+ struggling) elevate credit risk and NPL concerns. Star casino suspension hits gaming-adjacent revenue.
sectors.implications: Banks benefit from higher rates short-term but face deteriorating household credit quality. REITs pressured by higher borrowing costs and falling property valuations.

sectors.trend: Data centre boom straining energy supply ('energy bust'), supporting AGL, Origin, and renewable developers. 13 Bathla sites stood down due to funding gaps signal infrastructure project risk.
sectors.implications: Energy demand structural tailwind from AI/data centres; but project funding gaps create execution risk for infrastructure names.

sectors.trend: Card surcharge phase-out and cash comeback signal shifting payment dynamics. Renter stress and unemployment pressure discretionary spend. WES, WOW face margin pressure.
sectors.implications: Defensive consumer staples (WES, WOW) relatively resilient; discretionary retail under pressure from household balance sheet stress.

sectors.trend: US AI chip and networking stocks (AMD, Nvidia, Zscaler) showing rotation; data centre energy demand supports Australian tech infrastructure plays. Medicare hack raises cybersecurity concerns.
sectors.implications: ASX-listed tech (IFL, WCN) may benefit from domestic data centre buildout; cybersecurity spend likely to rise.

sectors.trend: Largest 40-year house price correction underway; CBD commercial tower listed at $40m; Dusty Martin portfolio haircut. Renters struggling signals potential tenant default risk.
sectors.implications: Property trusts (GPW, ICOL, DGL) face valuation compression and rising vacancy risk. Commercial property under pressure.

key_themes: RBA rate pincer: hiking into rising unemployment creates household squeeze
AUD depreciation as a two-edged sword: boosts miner earnings but raises import/inflation costs
Housing correction: 40-year high drawdown, Victoria worst-hit, renter stress at 50%+
ASX 4-week losing streak driven by bond yield climb, not equity-specific weakness
Junior gold exploration momentum vs. large-cap miner uncertainty
Cap raise dilution wave ($2.7B) pressuring small/mid-cap valuations
China-US diplomatic thaw providing partial commodity demand support
Data centre energy demand as structural tailwind for Australian energy sector

risk_assessment.risk_factor: RBA hiking into recession / unemployment surge
risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight defensive equities (WES, CSL, AGL); reduce leverage; monitor RBA statement language for pivot signals
Hedge FX exposure; favour AUD-earning miners (BHP, RIO) but monitor global commodity demand; avoid import-heavy retailers
Underweight property REITs and construction names; monitor mortgage arrears data; favour cash-rich balance sheets
Avoid pre-announcement small-caps; focus on cash-flow-positive juniors; monitor ASX cap raise pipeline
Diversify commodity exposure; monitor iron ore and LNG pricing; avoid over-concentration in single-commodity miners

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Energy supply constraints from data centre boom
risk_assessment.mitigation: Favour renewable and gas producers (SOL, AGL, WDS); monitor AEMO capacity warnings

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gold-exposed juniors with strong assay results
opportunities.rationale: Aurum 155g/t, Zenith 6/6 WA hits, Kuniko NSW drilling confirm resource potential; AUD weakness supports gold pricing; safe-haven demand rising amid rate uncertainty

opportunities.recommendation: Add to large-cap diversified miners on AUD weakness
opportunities.rationale: AUD depreciation boosts AUD-reported earnings for BHP, RIO; China-US détente supports iron ore demand; 4-week ASX selloff creates entry point

opportunities.recommendation: Position in energy/renewables for data centre demand
opportunities.rationale: Structural energy demand from AI data centres; 'energy bust' risk creates pricing power for generators; 13 Bathla funding gap highlights infrastructure scarcity

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive tilt to healthcare and consumer staples
opportunities.rationale: Rising unemployment and renter stress shift consumer spend to essentials; CSL and WES offer earnings visibility amid macro uncertainty

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce exposure to property REITs and construction
defensive_moves.rationale: 40-year house price correction underway; CBD commercial valuations compressing; renter stress at 50%+ elevates default risk

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD exposure and reduce leverage
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD 'trapdoor' depreciation raises import costs and inflation risk; RBA unlikely to cut soon given unemployment-driven rate pincer

defensive_moves.recommendation: Avoid small-cap names pending cap raise announcements
defensive_moves.rationale: $2.7B cap raise wave dilutes shareholders; brokers active but post-raise share prices typically underperform

defensive_moves.recommendation: Monitor Star casino suspension impact on gaming/entertainment
defensive_moves.rationale: Prolonged licence suspension removes revenue stream; broader regulatory risk to gaming sector

market_outlook.short_term: ASX likely to remain under pressure in 1-3 month window. Fourth consecutive losing week driven by bond yield climb and AUD weakness. RBA hawkish bias despite unemployment surge limits rate-cut expectations. Housing correction and renter stress weigh on consumer sentiment. Gold juniors and miners offer relative outperformance. Expect volatility around RBA communications and US-China policy developments.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook cautiously constructive if RBA pivots after unemployment peaks. Housing correction may stabilise by mid-2027. Data centre energy demand and gold exploration pipeline provide structural growth pockets. Key risk: prolonged rate pincer triggering credit cycle deterioration. China demand recovery would support materials sector. AUD likely to find support once global risk appetite stabilises.

China-US trade/diplomatic follow-through from Xi-Trump meeting
Iron ore and LNG price movements
ASX cap raise pipeline and small-cap dilution events
US Fed policy and global bond yield direction
